hook.en: Some equations cannot be separated, like dy/dx + y = x. But multiply by the right factor and the left side becomes the derivative of a single product. That factor is the integrating factor.
hook.kn: dy/dx + y = x ನಂತಹ ಕೆಲವು ಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಲಾಗದು. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಗುಣಕದಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ ಎಡಬದಿ ಒಂದು ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧದ ಅವಕಲಜವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ಗುಣಕವೇ ಅನುಕಲನ ಗುಣಕ.

objectives.en: Write a linear equation in the standard form dy/dx + Py = Q
Find the integrating factor e^{∫P dx}
Solve linear equations in y and in x

narration.en: Some equations cannot be separated, like dy/dx + y = x. But multiply by the right factor and the left side becomes the derivative of a single product. That factor is the integrating factor.
narration.kn: dy/dx + y = x ನಂತಹ ಕೆಲವು ಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಲಾಗದು. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಗುಣಕದಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ ಎಡಬದಿ ಒಂದು ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧದ ಅವಕಲಜವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ಗುಣಕವೇ ಅನುಕಲನ ಗುಣಕ.

body.en: A first-order linear equation has the form $\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q$, where $P$ and $Q$ are functions of $x$ only (or constants). Multiply by the integrating factor $\text{IF} = e^{\int P\,dx}$; the left side becomes $\frac{d}{dx}(y\cdot\text{IF})$.
body.kn: dy/dx + Py = Q, ಇಲ್ಲಿ P, Q ಗಳು x ನ ಫಲನಗಳು. ಅನುಕಲನ ಗುಣಕ IF = e^{∫P dx} ಯಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ ಎಡಬದಿ y·IF ನ ಅವಕಲಜವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪರಿಹಾರ: y·IF = ∫Q·IF dx + C.

points.en: Make the coefficient of dy/dx equal to 1 first
Solution: y · IF = ∫ Q · IF dx + C

narration.en: Write the equation as d y by d x plus P y equals Q. Multiply by the integrating factor, e to the integral of P. The left side becomes the derivative of y times the I F, so integrate both sides.
narration.kn: dy/dx + Py = Q, ಇಲ್ಲಿ P, Q ಗಳು x ನ ಫಲನಗಳು. ಅನುಕಲನ ಗುಣಕ IF = e^{∫P dx} ಯಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ ಎಡಬದಿ y·IF ನ ಅವಕಲಜವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪರಿಹಾರ: y·IF = ∫Q·IF dx + C.

blocks.formula: y\cdot e^{\int P\,dx} = \int Q\,e^{\int P\,dx}\,dx + C

narration.en: The teacher identifies P and Q, finds the integrating factor and solves a linear equation step by step.

say.en: A linear equation has the form d y by d x plus P y = Q, where P and Q are functions of x only.
Here P is 1 by x and Q is x squared. The integrating factor is e to the integral of P, which is x.
Multiply through by x. The left side becomes the derivative of x y.
Integrate: x y = x to the 4 by 4 plus C, so y = x cubed by 4 plus C by x.
Remember the recipe as a flow: identify P and Q, find the integrating factor, then use y times I F equals integral of Q times I F.

body.en: Sometimes the equation is linear in $x$: $\frac{dx}{dy} + P_1 x = Q_1$, with $P_1$, $Q_1$ functions of $y$. Then $\text{IF} = e^{\int P_1\,dy}$ and $x\cdot\text{IF} = \int Q_1\cdot\text{IF}\,dy + C$.
body.kn: ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಸಮೀಕರಣ x ನಲ್ಲಿ ರೇಖೀಯ: dx/dy + P₁x = Q₁. ಆಗ IF = e^{∫P₁ dy} ಮತ್ತು x·IF = ∫Q₁·IF dy + C.

points.en: Use this when y appears inside e, tan⁻¹ and so on
Everything is integrated with respect to y

narration.en: If the equation is linear in x instead, write it as d x by d y plus P one x equals Q one, with everything in y. The same method works with the roles of x and y swapped.
narration.kn: ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಸಮೀಕರಣ x ನಲ್ಲಿ ರೇಖೀಯ: dx/dy + P₁x = Q₁. ಆಗ IF = e^{∫P₁ dy} ಮತ್ತು x·IF = ∫Q₁·IF dy + C.

caption.en: Solutions y = e^{−x} + Ce^{−2x} of dy/dx + 2y = e^{−x}. Move C and watch every curve settle onto e^{−x}.

narration.en: Move C. The term C e to the minus 2x dies out quickly, so every solution approaches e to the minus x.

tryThis.en: Set C = 0: the solution is exactly e^{−x}.
Why do all curves look the same for large x?

steps.en: P = 1/x, Q = x². IF = e^{∫dx/x} = e^{log x} = x.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Solve dy/dx + y/x = x² (x > 0).

steps.en: y e^{2x} = ∫e^{−x}·e^{2x} dx = ∫eˣ dx = eˣ + C.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Solve dy/dx + 2y = e^{−x}.

body.en: Since e^{log f} = f, learn the common integrating factors: P = 1/x gives IF = x; P = −1/x gives 1/x; P = tan x gives sec x; P = cot x gives sin x; P = k gives e^{kx}.

narration.en: e and log cancel. Since e^{log f} = f, learn the common integrating factors: P = 1/x gives IF = x; P = −1/x gives 1/x; P = tan x gives sec x; P = cot x gives sin x; P = k gives e^{kx}.

narration.en: Recap. Standard form: dy/dx + Py = Q with P, Q functions of x. Integrating factor IF = e^{∫P dx}. Solution: y · IF = ∫Q · IF dx + C. If it is linear in x, swap the roles of x and y.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ರೂಪ: dy/dx + Py = Q, P, Q ಗಳು x ನ ಫಲನಗಳು. ಅನುಕಲನ ಗುಣಕ IF = e^{∫P dx}. ಪರಿಹಾರ: y · IF = ∫Q · IF dx + C. x ನಲ್ಲಿ ರೇಖೀಯವಾದರೆ x ಮತ್ತು y ಪಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಿಸಿ.
